title: SharePoint: edit, version, restore and copy site skills in Copilot in SharePoint
summary: Hold for corrections to automation and permissions claims. Microsoft documents file APIs that can edit the stored skill instructions, while the briefing reports no automation; it also extends the documented permission to create skills into an unverified permission to restore them. The audit-documentation gap needs to distinguish dedicated skill events from documented SharePoint file events.
